title: Economics v2.0 Phase 1: Mint tokens to validators
summary: Mint 5,000,000,000 MIRAGE (~5B) to each of the 4 validators to establish proper stake levels for the new tokenomics. This increases each validator's holdings to $50,000 equivalent at the target price of $0.00001/MIRAGE. See docs/economics_v2_upgrade.md for the full upgrade plan.
